page.overview:
What is Followers of Set?

The Mesu Bedshet (lit. "Children of Weakness"), commonly known as the Followers of Set or Setites, were a clan of vampires who believe their founder was the Egyptian god Set. For most of their history, they were inextricably linked to the Church of Set, the avenue through which they remained independent.

Orthodox Setite belief dictates that Set will one day return to rule or consume the world, and devout Setites prepare the way for his resurrection. To this end, the clan remains independent of the sects of other Kindred, and practice with great skill the arts of corruption, deceit and ancient sorcery. They refer to themselves as the Children of Rebellion.

As of V5, the clan has rebranded as the Ministry, de-emphasizing its ties to Set and embracing their role as the priests of vampire-kind. The cult that continues to revere Set survives as the Church of Set.

In the First Nights, the Clan was fairly centered around its Antediluvian and, not surprisingly, Egypt. Many different tales are told about his divinity and how he was cursed by Ra in his struggle against his rival Osiris, whom he eventually managed to kill, and his abandonment by his disciples and fellow Antediluvians. In the manner of the Path of Typhon, all these accounts are taken for true, because limitation to just one version is just another sign of the influence of Ra and Osiris in this world.
